meta.status: OWNER REVIEW REQUIRED — proposed rates, not published. Do not copy into the live site until approved.
notes: Ranges anchored on competitor prices cited in 'evidence' (IDs from competitor_prices.csv).
Labour/parts splits are estimates; only Pitcrew labour figures (C058, C060, C061) are published as labour-only.
ownerToSet = no competitor publishes a price; inspectionRequired = show 'Inspection required — request a quote'.
partsQuotedSeparately = labour range only; the current calculator shows parts as ₹0, so it needs a small UI change to say 'parts quoted by model'.

defaultCategoryFactors.basis: Sedan 1.15 / SUV 1.35: midpoint of competitor category steps — YMO hatch→SUV 1.20 (service), 1.60 (AC), 1.40 (interior), 1.22 (panel); Pitcrew lowest→5th service tier 1.63. Luxury: competitor luxury multiples range 1.5x–10x (YMO, conflicting), so default = quote after inspection.

detailing.note: Spans exterior wash (CD-01) to deep interior cleaning (CD-03); consider splitting into separate calculator options.

calculatorPricingProposal.luxuryNote: Competitor luxury multiples range from 1.5x to 10x and conflict (YMO). Recommend luxury = inspection required unless the owner sets a factor.

pickup.basis: GaadiMech, GoMechanic, YMO and Pitcrew all advertise free pickup & drop (C001, C106, C070, C044).

calculatorPricingProposal.taxes: Only Pitcrew states prices include GST. Decide whether to show prices incl. GST before enabling taxes.
